reason: When I need solar I will call the installer my cousin used and ask my neighbours. I do not know these companies on an app, and ratings on a website I have never heard of do not mean much to me next to someone I can see.
objection: Who are these companies and who is checking them? Anyone can write a good rating. If the installer does a bad job, the app cannot come to my house and fix it.
would_change_my_mind: If my relative or a neighbour told me they got a good installer through SunXFinder and the price was better than the one we know, then I would send a request, maybe through WhatsApp.
